  1.  Review San Dimas` Portion of the  The City Council discussed a regional

  parking impacts.

  Bring the amended agreement back to

  Design / Phasing:

  Develop a phased implementation strategy
  prioritizing Bonita Avenue, with:

  Grant funds used for ADA ramps,
  pedestrian and median improvements,
  and associated striping/ signal work
  where eligible.

 2.  Legal Guidelines and Policies Regardin  Council and staff reviewed and affirmed
  Disruptive •  and Speech During
  City Council Meetings  I  treating council meetings as a limited public
  forum, with public comments required to
  relate to City business or matters within the
  City Council' s jurisdiction.

  Direction was given to enforce
  decorum rules consistently for in -
  person and Zoom participants,
  including time limits, warnings, and, if
  necessary, removal for off -topic
  remarks,  irrelevant personal attacks,
  gratuitous profanity, racist language,
  threats, nudity, or other disruptive
  conduct.
  Council supports the use of Zoom
  webinar features such as a waiting
  room, renaming inappropriate screen

  names,  prohibiting
  masks/ filters/ emojis ( except
  background blur), requiring cameras
  on for Zoom speakers ( with phone- in
  exceptions),  and applying the same
  content rules to signs and visual
  displays as to spoken comments.
  Council supports any council member
  calling for a point of order and request
  a brief recess to allow the Mayor, City
  Attorney, and staff to confer on how to
  handle disruptive or questionable
  conduct before proceeding.
  Staff was directed to develop and
  implement operational protocols for
  handling " Zoom bombing" and other
  disruptions, including the ability to cut
  video/ audio, temporarily recess the

  meeting, and, if needed, terminate  or
 Approve Minutes of the June 9, 2026 City Council Study Session  Page 3

  disconnect  the Zoom  session  while

  protecting the City' s network.
  The Council supports a structured
  public comment period at study
  sessions, including possible shorter
  time limits and defined comment
  periods, and requested that staff work
  on a clearer framework for study
  session public participation.
  Staff was asked to prepare
  standardized  scripts  and/ or recorded

  announcements to explain public
  comment and Zoom participation  rules
  at the beginning of meetings and to
  those in the Zoom waiting room.

The meeting recessed at 6: 55 PM.
Reconvened at 9: 20 PM
Adjourned at 10: 15 PM
